# GRUPO ERVOY

> GRUPO ERVOY, S.A. de C.V. is a Mexican company based in Monterrey, Nuevo León, that helps European manufacturers prepare their products for sale in Mexico and enter the Mexican market: market research, Mexican NOM standards and labelling, local representation, import and logistics, distributors and trade shows. The team works in Spanish, English and Polish. The first consultation is free.

- Address: Cambridge 103, 64349 Monterrey, N.L., Mexico
- Email: info@grupoervoy.com
- Contact: https://grupoervoy.com/en/contact/
- Own brands in Mexico: Simple Made Blinds Mexico (https://simplemadeblinds.mx), Polaca Foods (https://polacafoods.lat)
- Languages of this site: Polish (default, https://grupoervoy.com/), Spanish (https://grupoervoy.com/es/), English (https://grupoervoy.com/en/)

## Services

- [Market research and strategy](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/market-research/): We analyse competitors, prices, sales channels and regulatory requirements for your product in Mexico and finish with a clear recommendation.
- [Getting your product ready for Mexico](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/product-compliance/): We check your product's requirements: tariff classification, NOM standards and certification. We prepare labelling that complies with Mexican rules.
- [Your local partner in Mexico](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/representation/): Local representation for European companies in Mexico. Operate in the market without setting up your own company straight away, under a contract with GRUPO ERVOY.
- [Import and logistics](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/import-and-logistics/): We help you set up importing into Mexico, choose the right partners and coordinate the first shipments from Europe.
- [Distributors and sales growth](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/distributors/): We find and vet distributors and trading partners in Mexico, arrange the first contacts and support your sales growth.
- [Trade shows and promotion](https://grupoervoy.com/en/services/trade-shows/): We help European companies take part in trade shows in Mexico: choosing the event, the stand, Spanish-language materials and follow-up after the show.

## Knowledge base

- [How to start selling your product in Mexico: first steps](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/first-steps/): Where to start if you're planning to sell in Mexico: the order of steps, the key decisions and where manufacturers most often lose time.
- [NOM standards: how to check whether they apply to your product](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/nom-standards/): What Normas Oficiales Mexicanas are, when they apply and how to work out which requirements apply to a specific product.
- [Your product's tariff code: why it matters so much](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/tariff-code/): The tariff code affects duties, regulatory requirements and import paperwork. How it's determined and when it's worth getting an official ruling.
- [Importer of record in Mexico: who can do it](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/importer/): Who can be the importer, what role the importer plays in the process and what options you have if your company doesn't yet have its own structure in Mexico.
- [Origin of goods and duties in EU–Mexico trade](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/origin-and-duties/): How to prove preferential origin, which documents you may need and why it pays to have them ready before shipment.
- [Food labelling in Mexico and NOM-051 warning seals](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/food-labelling/): How the black warning seals on packaging work, what they mean for label design and when a certificate of label compliance is worth having.
- [Who can hold a NOM certificate](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/nom-certificate-holder/): What options a manufacturer outside Mexico has and why the choice of certificate holder matters for importing and selling later.
- [Mexico's 2026 customs reform: what changed](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/customs-reform-2026/): The main changes to Mexican customs law in 2026 and what they mean for companies importing into Mexico.
- [Trade shows in Mexico: calendar](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/trade-shows/): The trade shows that matter most for European manufacturers in Monterrey, Mexico City and Guadalajara, with dates, venues and a short description.
- [Glossary: trade and import in Mexico](https://grupoervoy.com/en/knowledge/glossary/): The Mexican terms you'll meet most often in import, customs, certification and trade, explained in plain English.
